$comment: Feature catalog for testing agents: dotnet run scripts/Screenshot.cs -- --list. 'page' is the @page template the entry covers (checked by FeatureCatalogTests); 'route' is what gets opened (query strings like ?dialog=add-entry open UI state directly), where {account:<name>} is replaced by the id of the account with that name in the nav menu. Guest accounts: Cash 1, Loan 1, Investments (stock/ETF), Bond 1.

features.description: Dashboard: net worth, balances and summary cards.
Assets overview and distribution.
Liabilities (negative currency balances) overview.
Investments dashboard across all investment accounts.
Owner history grouped by day, with transaction-kind, currency, date and text filters. Add (cash, bond or investment), Import / Export menu, and edit/delete on every row.
Owner history filtered by description, counterparty or instrument and date range from the URL (?search=<text>&range=Month|1M|3M|6M|YTD).
Add transaction dialog on the Transactions page, with a Cash / Bond / Investment toggle and no account choice. ?kind=cash|bond|investment only picks the kind it opens on.
Import a cash CSV statement into the pool of one currency, without choosing an account.
Import bond entries from CSV (the file names the bond per row), without choosing an account.
Detected recurring payments (subscriptions).
Cash flow forecast: projected balance chart and horizon deltas.
Cash balance, spending, large transaction and subscription alerts.
Automation: transaction labeling rules.
Account details of the cash (currency) account Cash 1: balance chart and history.
Account details of the loan account Loan 1.
Account details of the stock/ETF investment account (named Investments; also called Stock 1): holdings, trades, appreciation.
Account details of the bond account Bond 1.
Add transaction (add entry) dialog, open on the Cash 1 account. Any account opens it with ?dialog=add-entry; the Transactions page has its own add dialog (transactions-add-entry).
Add transaction (buy/sell trade) dialog, open on the Investments stock account.
Manage (rename/delete) the Cash 1 account.
CSV import for the Cash 1 account.
CSV export for the Cash 1 account.
Add a new account.
User settings.
Connect an MCP client (AI assistant) to the account.
